scenes.headline: How a probe monitor reads a model's activations
scenes.sub: A linear classifier on the residual stream, at the front of a cascade.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Panda! Probe monitors watch an AI agent by reading its activations instead of its scratchpad. Here's how one works, and where its real cost lives.

scenes.text: A probe is a linear classifier on an activation the model already computed, so it can watch every token without a second forward pass.
scenes.say: The idea: classify an activation the model already computed. Then every token can be watched, with no second forward pass.

scenes.title: The whole probe
scenes.say: A probe is one line of math.

parts.note: the residual-stream activation at one layer and token
parts.say: h is the activation at one layer and token, already computed.

parts.note: w and b are the whole trained probe: 4,097 floats
parts.say: w and b are the whole trained probe: four thousand ninety-seven numbers.

parts.note: one dot product and a sigmoid give a probability
parts.say: A dot product and a sigmoid make it a probability.

steps.say: The model runs its forward pass as usual. The probe only reads.
A forward hook copies the residual stream at layer thirty-one of forty-six, at the token where thinking ends.
The probe scores it. No second forward pass.
Below a low threshold, clear it. Above a high one, block it.

steps.note: the thresholds are the cascade's cost knob
steps.say: Only the uncertain middle band goes to an expensive LLM judge. So the threshold is the whole system's cost knob.

left.title: The probe itself
items: About three parts in ten million of the pass
left.say: The probe's own arithmetic is nearly free: about three parts in ten million of the forward pass.

right.title: The deployed system
items: Activations exported: 8 KiB per token, per layer
Escalations pay for judges and investigators
right.say: The system isn't. Activations must be exported, and escalations pay for judges. OpenAI measured monitoring at roughly twenty percent of inference.

scenes.title: Recall at 1% false positive rate
scenes.note: no eval-set size, ROC curve or AUROC reported
scenes.say: In the worked example, the probe caught ninety-seven percent at a one percent false positive rate, against nine for an LLM judge. The evaluation set's size isn't given.

scenes.text: The probe's dot product is nearly free; the system's cost lives in the threshold that decides what reaches the judge.
scenes.say: So the probe's dot product is nearly free. The system's cost lives in the threshold that decides what reaches the judge.

recap: A probe is a dot product and a sigmoid
It sits at the front of a cascade
The threshold sets what the judge costs
scenes.say: To recap: a dot product, a cascade, and a threshold that sets the bill.
